cross_check_change_test.name: precision-interval rule
cross_check_change_test.d_i: maximum number of decimal places among symbol i's stored adjustment=all closes (shortest round-trip decimal representation, trailing zeros not counted)
cross_check_change_test.rho: f(k)/f(p), f = r/a, consecutive common sessions p<k
cross_check_change_test.precision_degenerate: a_p - delta_i <= 0 or a_k - delta_i <= 0 -> BLOCKING data review
cross_check_change_test.coincidence: every detected change needs a retained split/dividend event with ex_date in (p,k]; every retained event needs a detected change (no precision exemption); split magnitude within 0.1% (frozen)
cross_check_change_test.pass: 0 unexplained detected changes, 0 unconfirmed events, all split checks within 0.1%, 0 precision-degenerate pairs
cross_check_change_test.blocking: any of the pass conditions violated
cross_check_change_test.fail_safe: coarser rounding, truncation or rounded raw closes produce extra detected changes -> BLOCKING, never a false pass

rationale.cross_check: rounding error of a stored adjusted close is an absolute bound (half a unit in the last stored place); its relative effect depends on price level, so any fixed relative tolerance is wrong in principle; the interval bound follows from the stored representation with no tuned constant and fails safe
rationale.not_1e-3: 1e-3 is the observed non-event noise ceiling of this snapshot; adopting it would fit the rule to this snapshot and leave 20 NVDA dividend dates undetectable

first_session_event_rule.scope: events with ex_date <= the symbol's first session present in both raw and all series of the snapshot
first_session_event_rule.treatment: listed in cross-check evidence; excluded from PIT TR index and accounting
first_session_event_rule.not_applicable_to: ex_dates falling in later missing-bar gaps (tested via (p,k] as usual)
